rationale.faithfulness: The reversible heat-bath walker's destination signature (psi = 1) fails in 5/5 testable units with a validated estimator; the detailed-balance flux test is unpowered. Scorecard A1 B1 C0 D0 E0 F1 G0 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: Operator rule: max-ent prices set occupancy, not hop destinations; destinations follow pi weakly (psi 0.44) and habit strongly (rho 1.9 nats), so redirect by naming targets. Methodological value: zero pair flux cannot test detailed balance against field-like rivals on finite agent paths.

one_line: Inconclusive: the strict co-alive rule leaves no testable unit and zero net flux is unpowered against age-drift and sink walkers; in five #51 attention units hop destinations are not heat-bath (psi 0.44 [0.41, 0.48], habit rho 1.9 [1.4, 2.4]).
